name: @cloudsforge/trade
description: Forge Trade — backtesting, paper and live trading bots. Carries the Crucible engine forward intact and fixes the concurrency defects around it: one settlement per period at the schema level, post-trade state written with the fill, leased jobs instead of timers, backtests off the request path, and capital held as a real ledger reservation.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). The ledger and billing both learned this the hard way.

_localDependencies: The @cloudsforge/* packages are consumed from sibling checkouts because none of them is
published yet. Once AD-02 lands they all become registry versions ('^1.0.0') and these paths —
plus the two build contexts in the Dockerfile — are deleted. Nothing else changes.
The runtime packages take 'file:' and the contracts packages take 'link:'. The difference is
not cosmetic: @cloudsforge/contracts-money depends on @cloudsforge/contracts-chain with the
'workspace:^' protocol, which only resolves inside the contracts workspace. 'file:' would make
pnpm try to resolve that transitive itself and fail; 'link:' symlinks the package in place and
lets it keep using its own already-installed node_modules.
